title: cancellation tokens observe explicit requests
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: async/cancellation: check() is cheap before a request and throws the builtin Cancelled afterwards; requested() observes the request.

notes: D-041: `Cancelled` is a builtin catch type not listed in spec 9.6.
